text:
hana: Drafting the release notes and changelog for tomorrow's docs deploy. Main pieces: SDK v2 rename sweep (method path changes), Console sidebar redesign (TOC moved), and i18n updates for FR/DE. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6792 PTAL
kevin: skimmed. two asks: (1) add a short migration checklist for SDK v2 (mapping table for common methods), (2) call out the Console TOC move so embedded links/bookmarks may change for customers using Deep Links
hana: added a mapping table and a short note about deep links that may need updating. Also added a small changelog bullet for Console: "Sidebar TOC relocated to left rail; deep links may require update." PTAL
meena: translation bot flagged some missing strings in the relnotes header for FR/DE. translate-bot: missing keys: relnotes.console.toc_note, relnotes.sdkv2.mapping_title
hana: thanks; added fallback English strings and pinged localization for final copy. marked as an advisory: translators will push patches before publish window
kevin: small code nit: Go SDK example still shows old method name `Client.Generate`  new v2 shape is `client.Text.Generate`. please update and add Rust example (customers ask about it)\hana: updated Go example and added a Rust snippet (lightweight example using reqwest). also included a tiny migration table for common patterns: e.g., `client.generate` -> `client.text.generate`, `client.stream` -> `client.text.create_stream`
meena: docs-ci: snippet tests queued
docs-ci: snippet tests failed on the Rust example due to timeout in CI runner; increased test timeout and retried
docs-ci: snippet tests passed on retry. linters: markdown-lint flagged long lines in relnotes/console.md; wrapped lines and re-ran
kevin: link-bot: linkcheck found a 404 at /guides/sdk/upgrading (should be /guides/sdk/upgrade-to-v2). Also flagged external: https://thirdparty.example/compat -> 410 archived. Converted to inline advisory note
hana: fixed links and removed dead external link. added an inline compatibility note instead of linking out. updated PR description
meena: ops request: please add a short "what to expect" in relnotes for Private customers: mention KMS key rotation window note (customers using customer-managed keys may need to reauthorize after deploy), and that some Console settings pages moved (update bookmarks)
hana: added KMS note and Console settings migration hints with screenshots reference. also added a short troubleshooting FAQ entry: "If a deep link 404s, search for the page title in Console > Documentation or use the admin redirect map."\easter_egg: hana: minor editorial: included a one-line changelog bullet for the release: "Docs: SDK v2 snippet rename, Console sidebar relocation, i18n updates (FR/DE)."
kevin: recommend adding a short rollout cadence in the relnotes so SEs know when to notify customers: publish to docs at 09:00 UTC, post to #announcements, schedule a 2-hour slow rollout for console feature flags (5% -> 20% -> 100% over 6h)
hana: added rollout cadence and a short ops playbook snippet for admin rollback: ```bash
# rollback console feature flag via admin API
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY\" \
  https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/feature_flags/console_toc/rollback -d '{"target":"0%"}'
```
meena: translate-bot: FR translations pending for two keys; marking relnotes as "pending i18n" in PR so we don't auto-publish until translators land fixes
docs-ci: deploy-preview URL: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/6792/relnotes-sdkv2-console. All internal links OK in preview.
kevin: LGTM aside from the FR keys. If translators won't land before publish window, suggest publishing EN and tagging relnotes as "i18n forthcoming" in the announcement
hana: noted. I'll coordinate with localization and either hold publish 1h or ship EN-first with clear i18n note. Planning to merge in ~12m. Any objections? :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
meena: +1
hana: merged and will wait for localization confirmation. thanks all!
